verdict.rationale: Morph documents a shared, token-billed OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API that serves "open-weight chat models" (plural), with prefix caching on "every open source model". However, the only named model is Kimi K3, so catalog breadth across the requested families is unevidenced. missing for 10: named Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS models in the serverless catalog, a published model list showing breadth, independent corroboration of the catalog (community notes only an older model listed on OpenRouter).
